title: A plate cooled by radiation: alone to warm surroundings and to 0 K, and with convection
source: The steady energy balance of a surface that radiates to large surroundings, q = ε σ (T_s⁴ − T_sur⁴), with convection q = h (T_s − T∞) + ε σ (T_s⁴ − T_sur⁴), and one-dimensional conduction through the plate (F. P. Incropera, D. P. DeWitt, Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, §1.2.3 and §1.3.1, the surface energy balance). The temperature through the plate is linear, the exact discrete solution of every hex8 mesh; the face temperature is the balance's root (closed form without convection, bisection to round-off with it)

quantities.reason: exact discrete solution: the temperature is linear through the plate, which every hex8 reproduces, and the radiating face's balance is solved to the Newton tolerance
